question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**weigh**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word to fill in blank no. 4 is "**weigh**", which means **to carefully consider and compare different options or factors before making a decision**.
 
• Here, it is used in the sense of **companies weighing the benefits and drawbacks of OBTs**.
